phrases.latin: Medicus aurēs tuās īnspiciet; nihil dolēbit.
phrases.english: The doctor will look in your ears; it won’t hurt.
see a doctor as soon as possible (said to Traupman’s sick girl)
We’re going to the doctor today.

phrases.latin: Medicus tē īnspiciet: ōs aperī, linguam exsere.
phrases.english: The doctor will look at you: open your mouth, stick out your tongue.
